summary.headline: Lots, Theft, and Inceptions
summary.text: Catalogue of folios 16–25v covering the chronocrator, prosperity, lots of wheat and barley, theft and stolen goods, identifying and locating the thief, inceptions including teaching, lunar harm by malefics, and buying slaves or other goods.
